sections.title: What to include
paragraphs: Please identify the page or material, describe the rights you claim and provide a reply address. If available, include an original source or other relevant evidence. Please avoid sending identity documents, private addresses or unrelated personal information.

sections.title: Review and action
paragraphs: We record the concern, review the identified material and available rights information, and may pause display while we investigate. Depending on the findings, we seek clarification or permission, replace or remove the material, or explain why it is retained. We tell you the outcome and revisit the decision if new information arrives.

sections.title: Privacy of requests
paragraphs: Private correspondence and evidence stay outside the public website and source repository. Only information needed to explain a material’s source or handling decision is made public. See the privacy notice for contact-data handling.
